enterprise-ai-fde/recap-and-handover-goa.summary: What enterprise customers ask before they trust Ask IT in production.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Review your production checklist and runbook from Stage 8. List **unresolved risks** (model cost, data retention, wrong answers).

sections.heading: Path
sections.body: **Reads** = security and observability vocabulary. **Labs 8A–8B** = Todo tracing and handover pack **with tutor**. **Assignment** = Ask IT security evidence and sponsor readout **on your own**.

objectives: Respond to core IT security questions with evidence from the application and its configuration.
Use Langfuse or an available tracing tool to inspect traces and evaluation runs.
Explain approved-model constraints, access controls, data handling and known limitations.
Prepare a handover package and concise sponsor readout.

enterprise-ai-fde/it-security-questionna.summary: Approved models, secrets, data flow, RBAC, logging, and retention.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body:
Retail IT will send a **security questionnaire**. You answer with **evidence** from your running Ask IT app—not promises.

- Approved models and where keys live
- Data flow (FAQ → retrieval → model → user)
- Staff vs admin access
- Logs and retention
- How sensitive store data is handled

enterprise-ai-fde/langfuse-traces-and-ev.summary: Traces, latency, cost, and regression evals—how FDEs prove quality.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body:
- **Traces** — see each `/ask` request: retrieval, model, tokens, latency.
- **Versions** — which prompt and model produced an answer.
- **Evaluations** — run your 20-question set and compare scores over time.
- **Alternate tools** — same ideas if your org uses something other than Langfuse.

enterprise-ai-fde/lab-8a-observability-a.summary: Tutored lab: Todo traces and evaluation snapshot (panel below).

sections.heading: Path
sections.body: Wire or inspect tracing on **Todo** first (smaller surface). Capture one trace screenshot and one eval failure you can explain.

sections.heading: Then
sections.body: Reuse the workflow on **Ask IT** in the final assignment.

enterprise-ai-fde/lab-8b-sponsor-readout.summary: Tutored lab: Todo handover pack structure (panel below).

sections.heading: Path
sections.body: Assemble README, architecture, limits, and runbook **for Todo** with your tutor—this is the template for the Ask IT handover.

sections.heading: Done when
sections.body: A peer can operate Todo for one day using only your documents.
